newsitem.title: USA: Summit Design elects new board.
newsitem.headline: Summit Design elects new board.

text.p: Summit Design Inc Monday said it has elected a board of directors, consisting of three new members and two previous members.
The two previous members are Amihai Ben-David and Larry Gerhard, the company's chief executive officer. New members are Steven Erwin, William Botts and Barbara Karmel.
"Our new board members add a depth of business and industry experience a young public company needs in this competitive environment," Gerhard said in a statement.

Erwin is chief financial officer of U.S. Bancorp in Portland, Oregon. Botts has served as chief executive officer for several companies including the cosmetics firm Hard Candy Inc and technology compy Aurora Electronics Inc.
Karmel is president of Reed Co, a management consulting firm. She has served on the board of directors for U.S. Bancorp and the United States National Bank of Oregon.
Ben-David has been a director of Summit since January 1994. He founded and heads DCL Technologies, Ltd, a publicly held company in Israel.
Summit Design Inc is a provider of engineering software products for design.
